steps.title: Daily Site Report
steps.ask: I want to fill today's daily site report.
fill: Daily report for the Kawartha Lakes Rural Resurfacing Program. Day shift, sunny and fourteen degrees. Dufferin Construction had four asphalt rakers, a paver operator and a roller operator on site, eight hours each. We ran the BOMAG paver and the BOMAG roller all day.
We placed forty tonnes of HL3 hot mix asphalt, and lost an hour in the morning waiting on the asphalt delivery.
